preferences.apiKey.description: Generation is billed to your own fal.ai account. The key is stored in your keychain and never leaves this computer.
preferences.apiKey.rejected: fal.ai rejected this key. Check that you pasted it in full and that it has not been revoked.
preferences.apiKey.unreachable: Could not reach fal.ai, so the key was not checked. Check your connection and try again.
preferences.apiKey.unexpected: Unexpected answer from fal.ai (status {{status}}). Try again shortly.

generate.prompt.label: Prompt
generate.job.noRefund: Cancelling stops the job. Depending on how far it got, fal.ai may still charge for it.
generate.job.abandoned: Still waiting on fal.ai. This generation will be picked up the next time you open the app.
generate.job.resumed_one: Picked up {{count}} generation still running from last time.
generate.job.resumed_other: Picked up {{count}} generations still running from last time.
generate.error.noApiKey: No fal.ai API key saved. Add one in Settings before generating.
generate.error.keyRejected: fal.ai rejected your API key. Check it in Settings.
generate.error.inputImageUnusable: There is no usable image to restyle. Pick a source first.
generate.error.inputImageNoneNamed: This run has no source image to restyle. Pick one first.
generate.error.inputImageNotOnDisk: The image this run would restyle is not in the project folder any more.
generate.error.inputImageUnreadable: The image this run would restyle could not be read.
generate.error.inputImageUnsupportedForm: The image this run would restyle is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP.
generate.error.inputImageTooLarge: The image this run would restyle is too large to send. Use one under {{limit}} MB.
generate.error.inputImageNoField: This model has nowhere to put a source image.
generate.error.requestRejected: fal.ai could not use this request.
generate.error.requestRejectedBecause: fal.ai could not use this request: {{detail}}
generate.error.rateLimited: fal.ai is rate limiting this key. Wait a moment and try again.
generate.error.offline: Could not reach fal.ai. Check your connection and try again.
generate.error.uploadFailed: Could not send the input image to fal.ai. Nothing was generated or charged — try again.
generate.error.jobFailed: fal.ai could not finish this generation.
generate.error.jobFailedBecause: fal.ai could not finish this generation: {{detail}}
generate.error.gaveUpWaiting: This is taking longer than expected. The job may still finish on fal.ai.
generate.error.couldNotSave: The image was generated but could not be saved.
editor.noCandidates: Nothing generated for this stage yet.
editor.nothingSelected: Nothing selected for this stage yet.
editor.promptStyle.prose: This model reads the prompt as prose. Describe the shot in sentences.
editor.promptStyle.tags: This model reads the prompt as a keyword list. Comma-separated tags work best.
editor.seed.collapsesBatch: A pinned seed makes every candidate identical, so a run produces one.
editor.strength.tooHigh: Above 0.85 the composition drifts, and at 0.95 the input is discarded.
editor.price.unknown: Price not checked for this model.
editor.action.restoreRecipeHint: Load this generation's recipe back into the parameters
editor.comparison.title: {{left}} vs {{right}}
editor.comparison.sameSeed: Same seed ({{seed}}), so anything that moved is a change you made.
editor.reason.noSeed: This model has no seed parameter, so its output cannot be reproduced.
editor.reason.noEndFrame: Looping needs a model with end-frame support.
editor.reason.noDuration: This model does not expose a duration.
editor.noProjects: No projects yet. Create one to get started.
editor.empty.title: Nothing open
editor.empty.description: Create a project to start. Its aspect ratio is chosen once, at creation, and every stage inherits it.
editor.newProject.title: New project
editor.newProject.description: Name it and pick an aspect ratio. The ratio is locked for the life of the project.
editor.newProject.name: Name
editor.newProject.aspectLocked: Locked at creation and inherited by every stage — video models are far pickier about this than image models.
editor.aspect.note.noVideoEnum: No video model confirms this ratio — stills only.
editor.reason.aspectNotAnimatable: No video model is confirmed to accept this ratio.
editor.deleteProject.title: Delete {{name}}?
editor.deleteProject.description: The folder, its assets and its recipe are removed from disk. This cannot be undone.
editor.error.save: Could not save the project. Your last edits are not on disk yet.
editor.error.cleanUp: Could not clean up the unused assets.
editor.upload.title: Bring in your own image
editor.upload.description: Use a picture you already have as this project's source. Drop it here, or choose a file.
editor.upload.dropHere: Drop the image to use it as the source
editor.upload.oneAtATime: Drop one image at a time. A source is a single picture, so nothing was brought in.
editor.upload.aspectMismatch: That image is {{found}}, but this project is locked to {{aspect}}. Nothing was added.
editor.upload.error.notFound: That file is no longer there.
editor.upload.error.unreadable: That file could not be read.
editor.upload.error.unsupportedFormat: That is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
editor.upload.error.unsupportedFormatIs: That is a {{format}} file. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
editor.upload.error.tooLarge: That image is larger than {{limit}} MB.
editor.upload.error.unreadableImage: That image looks damaged or incomplete.
editor.upload.error.couldNotSave: The image could not be saved into the project.

onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to Ideo
onboarding.welcome.description: A short setup — two minutes, and you can skip any of it.
onboarding.welcome.stages: Work in stages: a source image, a style pass, then animation. Each stage keeps its own candidates.
onboarding.welcome.cost: Generations are paid for at fal.ai. Ideo shows an estimate before you spend anything.
onboarding.welcome.browse: You can look around without a key. Only generating needs one.
onboarding.apiKey.title: Connect your fal.ai key
onboarding.apiKey.description: Ideo generates through fal.ai, billed to your own account.
onboarding.apiKey.validated: The key is checked against fal.ai as you save it, so a revoked key is caught here rather than partway through a paid job. The check itself is free, and the key is kept in your system keychain.
onboarding.firstProject.title: Create your first project
onboarding.firstProject.description: A project holds one idea and everything generated for it.
onboarding.firstProject.body: You will pick a name and an aspect ratio. The ratio is locked for the life of the project, because video models are far pickier about it than image models.
preferences.general.replayOnboardingDesc: Run through the welcome steps again, from the beginning.
editor.seed.pinThisHint: Reuse this candidate's seed on the next run, so only what you change changes.
editor.run.title: This run
editor.batch.hint: Each candidate is a separate paid call, so this is what one click costs.
editor.run.pick: Pick the one to keep. The rest stay in the strip below — nothing is deleted.
generate.error.someCandidates: {{failed}} of {{total}} candidates could not be submitted. {{reason}}
editor.preset.sourceHint: A source preset is a whole scene. Everything it seeds stays editable, and the ratio it names is a note about how it was composed — it cannot change this project's.
editor.preset.unsupported: This preset has no version written for {{idiom}}, so it cannot seed this model.
editor.preset.staleIdiom: This model reads prompts differently from the one this text was seeded for.
editor.preset.staleEdited: The prompt no longer says what the preset does.
editor.preset.deleteDescription: The saved preset is removed. Nothing you have already generated changes.
editor.preset.saveDescription: Saves the prompt, the strength and the negative prompt exactly as they are now, for models that read the prompt as {{idiom}}.
editor.preset.name: Name
editor.preset.unreadable: Some saved presets could not be read and were skipped.
editor.reason.alwaysLoops: This model always loops. It will not run without an end frame, so every clip returns to its first frame.
editor.preset.motionHint: Motion is a separate library from style, so any look can take any movement.
editor.preset.saveMotionDescription: Saves the motion prompt exactly as it is now, as a preset of your own.
editor.error.saveMotionPreset: Could not save the motion preset.
editor.error.deleteMotionPreset: Could not delete the motion preset.
export.title: Export
export.stillIsAPoster: A still exports as a poster image. Video needs a clip from the animate stage.
export.rewind.hint: Plays the clip forward, then backwards. Always seamless, but wrong for motion with a direction.
export.rewind.alreadyLoops: This clip already returns to its first frame. Rewinding still loops, at twice the length and twice the weight.
export.needsFfmpeg: Export needs ffmpeg, which is not on this machine. Install it and check again:
export.stillNotFound: Still no ffmpeg. Check that the install finished.
export.reason.nothingSelected: Select a candidate to export it.
export.reason.noFolder: Choose where the files should go.
export.reason.noFormats: Pick at least one file to write.
export.error.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg is not installed, so nothing was written.
export.error.noAsset: That candidate has no file on disk yet.
export.error.notAClip: That candidate is a still, so it exports as a poster rather than as video.
export.error.nothingRequested: No files were asked for, so nothing was written.
export.error.destinationUnusable: That folder could not be written to: {{detail}}
